leftEvidence.title: Jesus teaches disciples to ask for deliverance from the evil one

points.label: Speaker and petition
points.left: Jesus teaches disciples to ask for deliverance from the evil one
points.right: Jesus asks the Father to keep the disciples from the evil one while sending them into the world

points.label: Relation to the world
points.left: Prayer joins God’s name and kingdom with daily bread and forgiveness. It also asks not to be brought into temptation and to be delivered from the evil one.
points.right: The scene includes the revealed name, received words, and prayer. It also includes keeping, unity, and joy. It also includes the world’s hatred, the evil one, and truth. It also includes sending and sanctification. Together, these details stay in the same scene.

payload.posture: Read both WEBU passages side by side. Keep each passage’s actors, setting, order, and identity claims distinct.

rightEvidence.title: Jesus asks the Father to keep the disciples from the evil one while sending them into the world

payload.tension: One teaches a repeated prayer. The other shows Jesus praying for disciples he sends into the world.
payload.title: Deliverance from the evil one and Jesus’ prayer for keeping
